read.thesis: Marriott raised FY26 RevPAR guidance to 3%–3.5% and signed a record first half of deals (629,000-room pipeline), though Middle East RevPAR fell 43% and net rooms growth tracks the low end of 4.5%–5%.

capex.peers_comment: We are using less key money per signed deal than in 2019 and it feels like we are able to negotiate a bit less key money than some of our peers are offering.
capex.quote: investment spending to be $1.25 billion to $1.35 billion, an increase versus our prior expectations

gross fee revenues could rise 11% to $6.03 billion to $6.06 billion
